create_VERRolloutStorage: create a VERRolloutStorage instance with variable experience, num steps, num envs, and observation space
generate_ver_mini_batches: generate mini-batches for VER by shuffling sequences and slicing steps into num_mini_batch batches
compute_movements_for_aliased_swaps: compute the movements needed for performing swaps from source to destination with aliasing support
compute_returns: compute returns using GAE with gamma and tau parameters on the VERRolloutStorage buffers
recurrent_generator: generate recurrent mini-batches from VERRolloutStorage for VER training with optional advantages tensor
